description: This Java source file defines the MyJobService class, which extends Android's JobService. It handles scheduled jobs via the Android JobScheduler, including starting, stopping, and communicating job status updates to an activity using a Messenger.

classes.name: MyJobService
classes.description: An Android JobService implementation that handles scheduled jobs, communicates progress via Messenger, and manages job lifecycle events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and logs creation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the service and logs destruction.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Receives the Intent, retrieves the Messenger for callbacks, and determines restart behavior.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Starts the job; sends start message, waits for specified duration, then finishes job and sends stop message.

methods.name: onStopJob
methods.description: Handles job cancellation, sends stop message, and indicates whether to reschedule.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message via Messenger to the activity with job status updates.
